dict.string: Phase 0 of Total Ledger Awareness. Pulls server_definitions + server_info from the LOCAL rippled node every 6h and refreshes the ledger_definitions singleton in Neon (append-only history on hash change). Local-only by design — a public node would return a different build's vocabulary. If localhost:5005 is unreachable, walker_health flags STALE; no public fallback. Sentinels (Invalid: -1) are stripped in the walker so downstream three-way diffs stay alarm-only. StartInterval (rolling) preferred over StartCalendarInterval per feedback_macos_launchd_startinterval_over_calendar.
